mapper.select: select pro.P_Name as pName, con.Con_Name as conName, con.Con_Code as conCode, con.Con_Type as conType, con.Con_Money_Total as conMoneyTotal, con.Con_Pay_Clause as conPayClause, mn.* from Fund_Appropriation_Dtl mn left join Pre_Project pro on mn.P_Id = pro.P_Id left join Con_Contract con on mn.Con_Id = con.Con_Id where mn.Fa_Id = #{id} order by mn.Fad_Sort ASC

select pro.P_Name as pName, pro.P_Approve_Budget as pApproveBudget, c1.C_Name as cName, c1.C_Abbreviation as cAbbName, dep.D_Name as dName, fp.Fp_Code as fpCode, f.File_Relation_Id as fileRelationId, mn.* from Fund_Appropriation mn left join Pre_Project pro on mn.P_Id = pro.P_Id left join SYS_Company c1 on mn.C_Id = c1.C_Id left join SYS_Department dep on mn.D_Id = dep.D_Id left join Fund_Plan fp on fp.id = mn.Fp_Id left join SYS_File f on f.fileid = mn.id where mn.id = #{id}

select sum(Fad_Investment_Actual) as invCompleted, sum(Fad_Demand_Appr) as payTotal from Fund_Appropriation_Dtl mn left join Fund_Appropriation fa on fa.id = mn.Fa_Id where fa.State = 7 and mn.Con_Id = #{conId}
